description: Returns each player's projected fantasy points for the rest of the current season (weeks already played and his bye are skipped), with games_remaining and points_per_game. Use it for trades, waiver pickups and dynasty or keeper decisions. Filter by position, team or one player. Basic plan and above.

player_id.description: Only this player. GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.
player_id.title: Player Id

scoring.description: Fantasy scoring: ppr (full PPR, the default), half (half-PPR) or standard.
scoring.title: Scoring

team.description: Only this team's players. Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.
team.title: Team

name: get_ros_projections

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

note.description: A sentence for the user saying which plan is needed.

projections.description: Per player: projected points for the rest of the season, games_remaining and points_per_game.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.

title: Rest-of-season projections
